tasks.instruction: The cheap night rate of 3 per unit applies only for hours 0 through 5; from hour 6 on, the day rate of 5 per unit applies. p0 is the units used, p1 the hour.
tasks.note: Night window boundary; the wrong edit moves the boundary the other way.

tasks.instruction: The lift may carry p0 people and p1 bags when their total weight is at most the limit p2; a load exactly at the limit is allowed.
tasks.note: Helper call; the wrong edit swaps the helper arguments.

tasks.instruction: Below the target temperature p1 the heater uses 10 units per degree of difference; above it the cooler should use 4 units per degree, not 10.
tasks.note: select between two computed powers; wrong edit changes the heating factor instead.

tasks.instruction: The balance after a quarter: apply three monthly periods, each adding 5% interest (rounded down) and then subtracting the payment p1, starting from p0.
tasks.note: fold with two extra arguments; count off by one.

tasks.instruction: Climbing four flights costs what the step function sums for weight p0; the total must also include a one-time warm-up cost p1 added once at the end.
tasks.note: Inserted statement after a fold with one extra argument; wrong edit adds it once per flight.

tasks.instruction: p1 is the amount added to each of the four tanks in p0 and p2 is the tank capacity; return whether any tank would end up above capacity.
tasks.note: fold over an array with three extras; wrong edit skips the last tank.

tasks.instruction: Each tick should lose one eighth of the level (rounded down) instead of a quarter, and the function should run five ticks instead of three.
tasks.note: fold with a shift-distance extra; wrong edit changes only the shift.

tasks.instruction: The combo bonus of 5 per combo (p2) should be added to the base score only when there were no misses (p1 is 0); otherwise return the base score alone.
tasks.note: Inserted compare and select between two computed scores; wrong edit swaps the branches.

tasks.instruction: Make the pixel fully opaque: its alpha channel is the last of the four elements and must become 255; the color channels stay unchanged.
The function reports the charge percentage of p0 out of capacity p1 together with a low flag; the flag should be true exactly when the computed percentage is below 20.
tasks.note: Record result; a record is written as a JSON array of its fields.

tasks.instruction: Return true only when seat p1 is the seat directly after seat p0 and both are in the same row (rows hold four seats).
tasks.note: Helper calls plus inserted adjacency test; wrong edit drops the row check.

tasks.instruction: The bill p0 plus a tip of p2 percent is split among p1 people; when p1 is 0, return the whole bill including the tip instead of dividing.
tasks.note: Helper call with an inserted zero guard; wrong edit forgets the tip in the guard.

tasks.instruction: This packs 8-bit red, green and blue into a 16-bit RGB565 value; green has six bits in that format, so it should keep its top six bits rather than five.
Health p0 takes the damage left after armor; health must never wrap below zero, so when that damage exceeds the health, return 0.
tasks.note: Helper call plus inserted guard; wrong edit compares raw damage.

tasks.instruction: Turn on bit number p1 in the flag word p0, leaving all other bits as they are.
tasks.note: Shift operand order; wrong edit toggles instead of setting.

tasks.instruction: This steps a linear congruential generator from seed p0; its output should be bits 16 to 30 of the new state, a number from 0 to 32767.
tasks.note: Mask constant; wrong edit shifts by 15.
